name: Yaaru Potta Kodu
description: In a village trapped by untouchability and superstition, a determined teacher and his students challenge long-standing injustice. Their fight sparks a powerful movement that unites the community and threatens the local oppressor. As hope rises and conflict intensifies, the village stands at a decisive moment where courage must overcome the shadows of the past.

name: Yaarra Antha Paiyan Nanthan Antha Paiyan
Yuva
description: Gangwar in an engineering college escalates into a war.

name: Youth
description: Youth follows 15-year-old Praveen as he enters adolescence determined to find true love before school ends. Through a series of relationships and heartbreaks, he gradually discovers the real meaning of love, shaping his maturity and outlook on life.

name: Yuddhakaanda Chapter 2
description: "Yuddhakaanda Chapter 2" is a Kannada courtroom drama starring Krishna Ajai Rao, and Archana Jois. The film explores the legal battles of a mother and child rape victim in gripping courtroom dynamics.

name: Yaaradi Nee Mohini
description: Vasu falls in love with Keerthi at first sight. However, things change when she reveals that her marriage has been arranged with her uncles son, who turns out to be Vasus best friend.

name: Yogida
description: Yogida is the story of Yogi, an honest police inspector who uncovers the murder behind a staged suicide. Punished with a transfer to Vyasarpadi, North Chennai, she takes on feared don Shekar Babu and his grip over crime, police, and politics, choosing justice over compromise.

name: Yellow
description: Yellow is a Tamil movie starring Poornima Ravi, Vaibhav Murugesan, Sai Prasanna and Namitha Krishnan Moorthy in prominent roles. It is written and directed by Hari Mahadevan.

name: Yolo
description: Shiva finds himself mysteriously wedded to Deekshitha, a stranger. As they seek answers about their unexpected union, they unwittingly stumble into a chilling mystery that defies explanation.

name: Yaadhum Ariyaan
description: Two friends and their girlfriends on a forest getaway face horror when one girl dies mysteriously in an isolated bungalow. Panic sets in, and their desperate decisions to cover up the incident spiral into a far more terrifying ordeal.

name: Yeman Kattalai
description: Caught between guilt and desperation, Guru`s life spirals after he steals the precious jewels of Kamali, a bride-to-be whose dreams are shattered by his betrayal. Overwhelmed by remorse, Guru chooses to end his own life, only to find himself face-to-face with Yaman in the afterlife. Offered a rare second chance, Guru must right his wrongs and fight to reclaim both honour and love. As fate weaves a new path, Guru embarks on a journey of redemption that leads to an unexpected and heartfelt union.

name: Yamakaathaghi
description: A young girl's spirit lingers at a rural funeral home, unwilling to depart. Her mysterious death sparks an unsettling supernatural investigation.

name: Yosi
description: A student named 'Madhuvan' fears about clearing the NEET Medical Entrance exam due to the mental stress and decides to commit suicide. Luckily, he survives, but gets stuck inside a deep forest which is not at all connected to the ...

name: Yaavarum Vallavare
description: The story spans over the course of 12 hours - from 6 pm to 6 am. The crux of the movie propagates the idea that when a predicament arises, we need not await the arrival of a sole saviour. Instead, common people who rise to the occasion are heroes by themselves.

name: Yaaro
description: YAARO is an edge of the seat Horror Psycho Thriller that will have a pattern set against the backdrops of a murder mystery.

name: Yaadhum Oore Yaavarum Kelir
description: Punithan has a mysterious charm. He is not a riddle, though he appears to be one. Who is he? Where is he from? Where is he heading to? Why is he here? Answers will arrive only when he breaks his silence.

name: Yaanai Mugathaan
description: An autorickshaw driver is an ardent devotee of Lord Vinayagar. While he is an extremely religious person, he is unscrupulous in his day-to-day life. One day he finds he can't see his favourite god anymore.

name: Yaathisai
description: A periodical fiction based on the 7th-century Pandiyan prince Ranadheeran who ruled during a time when the Chola dynasty lost its power and its people were forced to live in the woods.

name: Yashoda
description: A pregnant woman named Yashodha, she is advised to follow a few guidelines about her physical and mental well being and safety. However, a set of events occur that make Yashoda live on the edge, risking her well being.

name: Yenni Thuniga
description: After a heist job by Madhan and gang to rob precious cargo becomes a mess, he is under pressure to deliver the loot to his overlords. Things begin to get complicated when Kathir appears and finally reveals what really happened tha...

name: Yaanai
description: PRVs family who lives with his two wives and children in Ramnad district.. Also, there is a family who is convinced that PRV's family only caused the death of his brother. The movie narrates many incidents that happen in the two families.

name: Yutha Satham
description: A young woman is murdered right in front of a police station. The inspector at the station suspects her boyfriend, a private detective, who claims he is innocent.

name: Yegathipathi
description: A portrayal of fishermen in Uttara Kannada, their language, lives and self-esteem. It examines the eroding relationship between police and the public, and the issues that arise when trust in authority declines.

name: Yaaro
description: Yaaro is an edge of the seat Horror Psycho Thriller that will have a pattern set against the backdrops of a murder mystery. The film is produced by TakeOk Productions and directed by Sandeep Sai, featuring Venkat Reddy and Upasana RC in prominent roles.

name: Yakshee
description: An unknown spirit guards Maya against any possible threats from eve-teasers and Don Juans. But what happens when true love flourishes between Maya and Ashwin Babu, and the spirit isn't all too happy about it?

name: Yaarada Avan
description: The story of the film depicts the individual lives of two young men played by Navdeep and Naveen Chandra. Each of them have their own problems and need money to come out of it. They try different things but fail with each attempt. Loosing no hope, each of them plan a huge robbery and somehow succeed in it. Twist in the tale arises when a drug addict played by Pradeep Machiraju enters their life ...

name: Yuddham Sei
description: A common man's ability to defeat the devil. A cop identifies the mystery and solves the problem.

name: Yaadhumagi Nindraai
description: This is a story that needs to be told to the world. It's the story of several unknown faces hidden in the glamorous world of cinema. It's the voice that screams to be heard. Yaadhumagi ...

name: Yemaali
description: Malis world is turned upside down when his girlfriend announces her decision to break up with him. Vengeful and embittered, he plots to murder her with the help of his confidant Aravind. Things are about to take a dark turn as the duo get embroiled in their morbid schemes.

name: Yatchan
description: Two passionate people with dreams swap places accidentally by fate and their common key to get back their lost life is to defeat the antagonist through the girl whom he wants dead since she can foresee the future.

name: Yagavarayinum Naa Kaakka
description: The hero has some problems with Mudhaliar.

name: Yeman
description: The Machiavellian tactics of politicians in Tamil Nadu form the subject of this dark film.

name: Yatra
description: Yatra focuses on certain events leading up to YS Rajasekhara Reddy's (YSR) padayatra or journey on foot across Andhra Pradesh in 2003. During the course of the journey YSR learnt about the ...

name: Yennamo Yedho
description: Gautam and Nithya become friends. Will the friends turn lovers?

name: Yenda Thalaiyila Yenna Vekkala
description: The story of Yenda Thalaiyila Yenna Vekkala revolves a young engineering graduate who is trying to settle down in life. Just as everything seems to be going fine for him, in an unfortunate incident he gets picked up a mystical force for an entertainment play down and is forced to finish certain anonymous tasks or face death.

name: Yennai Arindhaal
description: Sathyadev, a sincere police officer, tries to stop an organ trafficking racket. But he is unaware that the man performing the illegal trade is the same person who killed his beloved.

name: Yaamirukka Bayamey
description: Is a ghost haunting Kiran's ancestral property? Or is it a conman's master moves?

name: Ziddi Ishq
description: Mehul's one-sided love is so strong and eternal that she will do anything for her crush - in life or in death

name: Zhagaram
description: A youngster sets out in search of a treasure based on the clues left behind by his grandfather.

name: Zombie Reddy
description: Mario, a game developer, and his friends must tackle and escape from a rising zombie apocalypse in the region of Rayalaseema.

name: Zombie
description: Zombie is a Tamil movie starring Yogi Babu and Yaashika Aanand in prominent roles. It is a drama directed by Bhuvan Nallan.

name: Anali
description: Set over a single, harrowing night, the story follows Jansi and her eight-year-old child as they are caught amid looming Third World War tensions and hunted by three ruthless men Lal Chetta, Khan Bhai, and Ranga Reddy, more dangerous than wild animals. With survival at stake, Jansi relies solely on her intelligence and resolve to outwit her pursuers and bring the nightmare to an end.

name: Mareechika
description: Set in Hyderabad, the story is a postmodern crime thriller/mystery that follows the events surrounding the disappearance of Mareechika. The story takes a mysterious turn when it's revealed that Sanju and his best friend Venkat Laxmi (Anupama Parameswaran) killed Mareechika for their own selfish reasons, and now they have to face the consequences of it.

name: Drishyam 3
description: Georgekutty must outsmart the law one last time when his past returns, threatening everything he did to protect his family.

name: Brothers And Sisters
description: Brothers and Sisters is a Tamil family comedy-drama series directed by Chidambaram Manivannan. The plot follows the Ponmalar household, whose strict, respected patriarch is secretly leading a double life with an extramarital partner. When the four siblings uncover the truth, they unite to protect their mother and preserve the family's honor.

name: Double Occupancy
description: A miraculous twist of fate binds two souls to a single body, with a woman emerging by day and a man by night. As they struggle to coexist, they must navigate love, identity, and a secret that threatens to upend their lives.

name: Karuppu
description: In a world where justice falters, a powerful guardian awakens. A superhuman rises in a rotten world to set things right in this high-octane fantasy entertainer.

name: Sshhh
description: Anthology series exploring human relationships. A teacher navigating sex ed, woman reconnecting with ex, wife awaiting missing husband's return, young man facing temptation amid future plans.

name: Raakh
description: Raakh is a haunting crime investigation that begins with the disappearance and murder of two teenagers in Delhi. Set in 1978, when such brutality was rare and shocking, the series follows the relentless manhunt launched to track down the killers while exploring the disturbing psyche of the men behind the crime.

name: Parimala and Co
description: A dark comedy centered around a chaotic family whose tangled relationships and unpredictable situations lead to emotionally charged and absurd moments, blending humor with underlying tension and drama.

name: M4M - Motive for Murder
description: Hyderabad is gripped by fear as a serial killer reenacts famous paintings through gruesome murders. ACP Krishna and investigative journalist Radha delve into the chilling mystery, tracing clues that point toward a former student and a school principal. With the clock ticking, they must unravel the killer's twisted motive before another masterpiece turns deadly.

name: Athiradi
description: An energetic student, Samkutty, revives a banned college festival, igniting a fierce rivalry that transforms celebration into chaos.

name: Moondram Kan
description: When a feared factory general manager is found murdered, the investigation exposes a web of buried resentment, trauma, and hidden agendas. As suspicion falls on multiple suspects, the case becomes less about identifying the killer and more about uncovering the reasons so many wanted him dead.

name: Habeebi
description: Set against the backdrop of a Tamil Muslim household, the film traces a timeless romance that unfolds across decades, connecting the past and present.

name: Peddi
description: In 1980s rural Andhra Pradesh, a spirited villager unites his community through sports to defend their pride against a powerful rival.

name: Dridam
description: A police officer arrives at a seemingly peaceful station but faces pressure when human remains are discovered. Given one week to solve the murder, he must navigate demands from his department and an anxious public seeking swift justice.

name: Anaganaga
description: A school teacher uses innovative storytelling methods to help struggling students, overcoming various challenges to achieve his goal.

name: Cheena Trophy
description: Cheenatrophy is a Malayalam movie starring Dhyan Sreenivasan and Kendy Zirdo in prominent roles.

name: Valavaara
description: Valavaara is a coming-of-age drama set in the picturesque landscapes of Sakleshpur, Karnataka. The story revolves around familial bonds, sibling rivalry, and responsibility, following the journey of Kundeshi, a young boy from a farming family, as he navigates love, loss, and the quest to find a missing cow that ties into his family's struggles.

name: Gullak
description: Set in quaint by-lanes in the heart of India, Gullak is a collection of disarming and relatable tales of the Mishra family.

name: The Rise of Ashoka
description: In the town of Avarathi, a barber community lives under the brutal control of a ruthless broker who exploits, humiliates, and silences anyone who resists. As fear and injustice rule their lives, a young man named Ashoka rises to challenge the oppression, leading a fight against exploitation, violence, and moral decay.

name: Kenatha Kanom
description: When villagers come together to solve their water shortage, they uncover shocking truths that reveal a much larger crisis.

name: KD The Devil
description: Set in the early 70s, Kaali unwittingly confronts underworld thugs, which in turn leads to a series of life-changing events. Will destiny be in his favour?

name: Patriot
description: After uncovering a deadly conspiracy linked to JP Sundaram, Daniel, a popular Malayali YouTuber known for exposing the truth, is forced to go on the run. Framed and hunted across borders, he fights back from exile only to uncover a far more dangerous nexus of power, technology, and crime.

name: Cousins Kalyanams
description: Follows six Keralan cousins over 26 years whose relationships and lives center around seven marriages.

name: Blast
description: A humble middle-class family skilled in martial arts finds their lives thrown into danger after crossing paths with a ruthless gang. Forced into a deadly conflict, they must stand together and fight against overwhelming odds in a battle filled with action, twists, and emotion.

name: Ugly Story
description: Neha's life unravels through love, fear, and hidden truths. What begins as a peaceful journey turns dark as she enters a new world shaped by Karthik's intense presence. As secrets surface and tensions rise, Neha is caught between love, control, and survival in an increasingly unsettling reality.

name: Batchmates
description: Four freshmen engineering students face unexpected challenges as they adjust to the harsh realities of college life and academic pressure.

A quirky 29-year-old named Sathya embarks on an unexpected journey of laughter, unlikely friendships, and self-discovery. Through hilarious misadventures and chance encounters, he slowly sees life's bigger picture - its surprises, joys, and second chances. Part rom-com, part drama, wholly feel-good, this story celebrates the beautiful mess of being human and finding happiness where you least expect it.

name: Sattendru Maarudhu Vaanilai
description: When a carefree orphan and a runaway ministers daughter marry on impulse, their love is soon tested by financial struggles and powerful enemies, from corrupt politicians to jealous rivals. As they navigate these challenges together, they uncover hidden truths and discover that love can endure even in the face of the darkest threats.

name: Momacu
description: On a freezing winter night in rural Haryana, three men steal an ATM and hide it in a tube well room. Overnight, mistrust and chaos shatter their desperate plan.

name: Carmeni Selvam
description: A content man's life turns chaotic when money fever strikes. His newfound greed leads to a series of amusing situations that unfold in this humorous tale.

name: System
description: Neha Rajvansh, a privileged public prosecutor, climbs the ladder of high-profile cases with the help of Sarika Rawat, a courtroom stenographer whose life sharply contrasts with her own. As their victories uncover buried injustices, rooted in societal realities of millennial India where power defines truth, Neha must decide whether to inherit her legacy or rewrite it by fighting for justice.

name: Derby
description: A campus entertainer that follows a group of college students navigating friendship, rivalry, love, and ambition. What begins as carefree fun soon turns into intense competition as campus pride and personal egos come into play.

name: Jetlee
description: SwingFisher 6EB1CH follows a passenger flight carrying fugitive billionaire Prajapathi that spirals into chaos when mercenaries and covert agents collide mid-air. Amidst the unravelling mission, special agent Shivani Roy fights for control while a mysterious protagonist wakes up in the aircraft's bathroom with no memory and a deadly secret hidden inside him.

name: Kara
description: Kara is set in Ramanathapuram in 1991, against the backdrop of the intense war between Iraq and the United States. Over the course of 16 days, Karasaami is forced to confront parts of his past he had chosen to leave behind. As he strives to protect and support those who depend on him, he faces unexpected consequences and life-altering turns.

name: Resort
description: A 12th-fail room service boy rises to challenge a ruthless kitchen at a luxurious beachside haven.

name: Leader
description: An ordinary man gets caught in a conflict between the underworld and the police. As tensions rise, he must navigate this dangerous situation while protecting himself and those close to him. The story unfolds as a gripping tale of survival, courage, and resilience in the face of escalating threats.

name: Warrant
description: Koattai Karuppusami, a soft-spoken constable struggles for respect in a brutal police force. Pushed to his limit by humiliation and violence, he becomes a feared enforcer, making others question if he still upholds the law or threatens it.

name: Kattalan
description: When the hunt for power meets the price of survival, the Ivory cartel war ignites a brutal saga - a gripping tale of dominance, revenge, and endurance in a world where mercy dies first, and only the wildest will survive

name: Faces
description: Told through Nithya's point of view, the story follows her battle with PTSD after a fire accident at home. As she recovers, she begins seeing the face of her missing boyfriend, Michael, in every man she meets, intensifying her trauma. Her search for answers slowly reveals what happened to Michael while forcing her to confront the darkness within her own mind.

name: Nawab Cafe
description: When Raja takes charge of his father's Nawab Cafe, something he never truly valued, hidden challenges emerge, forcing him to step up and protect his family's legacy.

name: Vikram On Duty
description: Vikram accepts the challenge of a case requiring a bold statement and justice for the victim.

name: Gaayapadda Simham
description: Darahas travels to America in pursuit of love, only to return deported and broken. Back home, he is drawn into a dangerous cat-and-mouse chase between the police and Satya Logistics. Forced to fight for survival, the wounded lion must rise and reclaim his strength.

name: Red Label
description: Red Label is a Tamil movie starring Lenin, Azmin Yasar, R V Udhayakumar, Anumohan and Munishkanth in prominent roles. It is directed by K R Vinoth.

name: Madhuvidhu
description: When Amrutharaj, a groom from an all-male household repeatedly rejected by brides' families, falls in love with Sneha Marcose, their journey toward marriage ignites a chain of hilarious chaos inside his unruly home.

name: Sathi Leelavathi
description: A newly married couple navigate the playful push and pull of married life, as the spirited wife takes charge, turning everyday conflicts into a series of fun and heartfelt moments. A light-hearted entertainer about love, laughter, and the beautiful chaos of togetherness.

name: Anthony
description: Anthony is a Tamil movie starring Kayal Vincent, T.J. Bhanu, Arul Dass, Nizhalgal Ravi and Kalaivalari Saga Ramanathas in prominent roles. It is directed by Sukirthan Christhuraja and Jenosan Rajeswar.

name: Exam
description: A young woman infiltrates a dangerous exam paper-leak network threatening thousands of students' futures. As she exposes the corruption, she risks everything to dismantle a system that reaches the highest levels of power.

name: Son Of
description: When an entitled young man drags his father to court for failing his duties, the shocked father responds in a powerful, unexpected way, unfolding a gripping courtroom battle that ultimately teaches the son the true meaning of responsibility, love, and family.

name: Karaa
description: Some predators cannot be outrun. A gripping, edge-of-your-seat experience filled with heart-stopping twists and jaw-dropping moments.

name: Dhurandhar The Revenge
description: Dhurandhar The Revenge introduces Jaskirat Singh Rangi, tracing the chain of events that compel him to become Hamza Ali Mazari, and follows his rise as he operates deep inside Pakistan. The film is set to return this time in Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada and Malayalam.

name: Thimmarajupalli TV
description: In a remote village in 1996, where a single television brings the community together, its sudden disappearance sparks chaos and suspicion. As the search begins, one man gets entangled in the mystery, leading to unexpected consequences.

name: Vellakuthira
description: Vellakuthira follows Kathir, a greedy man whose hunger for wealth drags his family into a financial crisis. Forced to flee after a violent confrontation, Kathir, his wife Kayal, and their son move to their ancestral village, hoping for a fresh start. But old habits die hard - when Kathir discovers a local herbal drink with great market value, temptation strikes again. As he chases profit and the villagers fight against exploitation and neglect, the story unfolds into a gripping tale of greed, redemption, and survival.

name: Kartavya
description: A police officer faces a moral dilemma when threats endanger his family, forcing him to choose between protecting his loved ones and honoring his oath to serve justice.

name: Mr X
description: When a lost nuclear device resurfaces in the enemy's hands, India orders the execution of its own captured spy. A rogue agent defies orders, uncovering a conspiracy that may ignite World War III. Inspired by real espionage, honey trapping and nuclear threats, Mr. X is a relentless race against time that never stops from the word go.

name: Kaalidas 2
description: After battling inner demons, Kaalidas, Part 2, turns more complicated as cop Kaalidas faces eerie murders striking across the city. Veiled provocateur Stephen unleashes deadly chaos inside and out, forcing a twisted hunt for crime, punishment, and the hidden truth.

name: Krishnavataram Part 1 The Heart
description: A grand retelling of Krishna's journey, told on a breathtaking scale. A visual spectacle made for the big screen. A story of love, devotion and wonder.

name: Arjun SO Vyjayanthi
description: In order to protect the people of his village, a man becomes a ruthless vigilante against his police officer mother's wishes.

name: Neelira
description: Under distress in the civil war of the 1980s, a family

name: Satan The Dark
description: During the era of the East India Company, a failed witchcraft ritual in Asthinapuram unleashes a dark curse that haunts the village for generations. Years later, a young man must confront this terrifying past to save the woman he loves from its deadly grip.

name: Dacoit A Love Story
description: An explosion of guns and roses, betrayal and trust, and, above all, love and loss.

name: Ek Din
description: Dinesh Kumar Srivastav, aka Dino, a sincere, socially awkward, trivia-loving nerd, is secretly in love with his co-worker, the beautiful Meera Ranganathan. Way out of his league! So, when the entire office travels to Japan for the annual company offsite, a heartbroken Dino makes a wish at the famous Fortune Bell that Meera be with him for just one day, not realizing that this one wish will throw his and Meera's lives into total chaos!

name: Justice for Jeni
description: Jeni and Priyanka are best friends and promising medical students with big dreams. But their world shatters when Jeni is brutally raped and dies. Devastated and furious, Priyanka sets out to seek justice, only to confront the harsh realities of the legal system and the painful truth about power and justice.

name: Oh Butterfly
description: When a woman brings her partner to an isolated hill house to reveal a life-changing secret, strange events begin to occur as her past collides with her present.

name: Vaazha II Biopic of a Billion Bros
description: Four friends, Hashir, Alan, Ajin and Vinayak are considered losers and troublemakers by parents, family, and the school management. They face immense social pressure as they reach adulthood, which embarks them on an emotional journey of self-discovery and acceptance, where they finally learn to take up their responsibilities and find success and peace, not in a traditional sense but by dealing with life on their own terms.

name: Bharathanatyam 2 Mohiniyattam
description: The family's journey to Sreekandapuram to settle the late Bharathan Nair's second wife and son takes a dark turn when an issue from his past resurfaces, leading to an unexpected crime. Forced into a desperate cover-up to protect their future, the family must navigate a treacherous path of secrecy and mounting pressure, determined to overcome any obstacle by any means necessary.

name: Love Insurance Kompany
description: In a world where everything can be insured, a company dares to insure love. An app predicts heartbreak and controls relationships through calculated risk. The voice behind it believes love is just data until he feels it himself. When the system flags his own relationship as a failure, it begins pulling them apart. He discovers the app doesn't just predict love, it manipulates it. Now, he must choose between the system the whole world believes in, set in 2040 and the heart and the purest form of love he can't silence.

name: Cup
description: The film focuses on the story of a teenager named Nidhin Babu from Vellaramkunnu, Idukki.

name: Glory
description: After a violent incident tears a family apart, a renowned boxing coach must face his two sons again. As they pursue Olympic dreams, buried conflicts resurface and revenge threatens to destroy everything they've built.

name: Karikaada
description: Fuelled by divine love, Kaadas journey evolves from a hunting legacy into a thrilling saga of adventure, action, and romance, prompting him to leave his old ways behind.

name: Arivaan
description: Surya, an honest yet hot-tempered cop known for his encounter killings, is transferred to Neyveli following another controversial case. Soon after his arrival, a murder involving a woman named Vinisha shakes the town. As Surya dives into the case, he must navigate between truth and deceit to protect both love and justice.

name: Munna Michael
description: A young man, tries to follow the footsteps of his idol, The King of Pop, Michael Jackson.

name: Undekhi
description: A dancer is killed in a fit of rage at the wedding of the scion of the Atwal family. A cop comes looking for the girl, while a film crew wants to expose the Atwals for their heinous crime. The Atwals will go to any lengths to remove pawns.

name: The Kerala Story 2 Goes Beyond
description: Across three Indian states, three young women defy family and tradition for love, only to slip into unseen cages of control and silence. What begins as romance and rebellion mutates into manipulation and loss of freedom, until the women strike back, turning captivity into a battlefield for survival.

name: Viraaji
description: One night, ten people from various backgrounds got stuck at an abandoned mental asylum, and an uninvited person makes things worse. Why is he there?

name: Kayilan
description: Kayilan is a thriller drama directed by Arul Ajit. The movie features Ramya Pandian, Prajin, Manobala, Gnanasambandham and others.

name: Raakaasa
description: An NRI returns home after ten years, chasing love, but a single mistake awakens an ancient darkness feared by the village for generations. As the threat grows, love turns deadly, and his life hangs in the balance.

name: Biker
description: A familys pride and conflict collide as one man chases motocross glory, driven by grit, spirit, and the edge of danger.

name: Galatta Family
description: Galatta Family is a Tamil movie starring Vemal, Anicka Vikhraman, Thambi Ramaiah, Mottai Rajendran, Anandaraj and Meera Krishnan in prominent roles. It is directed by A. Sarkunam.

name: Prathichaya
description: A powerful corporate syndicate traps the Chief Minister of Kerala in a conspiracy, causing his reputation to crumble under the weight of mounting allegations. Determined to uncover the truth, his son John Varghese steps into a dangerous web of deceit and power to clear his fathers name and restore his familys honour.

name: Happy Raj
description: Happy Raj is a Tamil movie starring G.V. Prakash Kumar, Abbas, Sri Gouri Priya and George Maryan in prominent roles. It is written and directed by Maria Raja Elanchezian

name: Lechindi Mahila Lokam
description: Centers women's voices in a narrative of empowerment and resistance. The Telugu film weaves together diverse female experiences, examining how women balance societal expectations, personal goals, and systemic obstacles.

name: Kadukka
description: In a peaceful village, two young best friends fall for the same beautiful girl. What starts as friendship soon turns into a comedy-filled love war. Each tries to win her heart with charm, tricks, and emotions, but the girl has a s...

name: Pallichattambi
description: Pallichattambi is a Malayalam movie starring Tovino Thomas in a prominent role. It is directed by Dijo Jose Antony.

name: Azhaikkamal Vanthai
description: When Esha suspects her husband Jivan is hiding an affair, she hires a private investigator - only to discover he's secretly created Nyra, a lifelike AI woman. But when Nyra develops a dangerous obsession with Jivan and sees Esha as a threat, the wife must fight to survive against an intelligence designed to outsmart human

name: Shamitabh
description: The film is about two artistes - Amitabh plays an alcoholic while Dhanush is a mute actor, who comes to the big city with dreams in his eyes. Amitabh plays the voice artist for Dhanush and together they form Shamitabh. Thus begins the story of Shamitabh and their hidden rivalry.

name: Youth
description: Youth follows 15-year-old Praveen as he enters adolescence determined to find true love before school ends. Through a series of relationships and heartbreaks, he gradually discovers the real meaning of love, shaping his maturity and outlook on life.

name: Manithan Deivamagalam
description: Manithan Deivamagalam is a rural family drama where a humble man, played by Selvaraghavan, rises as a guardian figure amid a village conflict over land and faith. Rooted in true events, it explores sacrifice, spirituality, and the deep bond between people and their land.

name: Aadu 3
description: Aadu 3, the third installment of the popular franchise, is an epic fantasy in which a chaotic twist unleashes a Pandora's box of reincarnations across multiple timelines. What follows is nonstop madness, outrageous twists, and a full-blown comic spectacle.

name: TN 2026
description: Set in Pollachi, the story follows a powerful landlord, Sivalingam Mandradiyar, who becomes obsessed with a rising actor, Kukanth Kumar, believing he is the next M.G.R. He pours his wealth into shaping the actor's career and political future. But as ambition and fame grow, so does the risk of downfall. Will it lead to power or ruin?

name: Nee Forever
description: Ajay, a startup app developer, and Mathi, an aspiring director, enter a fake relationship while hiding their true identities from each other. What starts as a calculated arrangement soon turns into an emotional journey as unexpected feelings grow between them. But when the truth behind their lies begins to surface, their fragile bond is put to the ultimate test.

name: Kolai Seval
description: A family follows a 200-year-old tradition of visiting a forest temple when a woman becomes pregnant. When a nine-month-pregnant woman is taken there, she encounters unexpected danger, uncovering dark secrets behind the temple and the mysterious forest.

name: Mustafa Mustafa
description: A fast-paced comedy of errors about friendship, panic, and the modern nightmare of digital secrets going viral.

name: Valathu Vashathe Kallan
description: When a day spins dangerously out of control, Samuel Joseph drags veteran Circle Inspector Antony Xavier into the most critical case of his career. With time slipping away, Antony must race against the clock to uncover the truth before it's too late.

name: Matka King
description: An enterprising cotton trader in Mumbai starts a new gambling game called Matka, taking the city by storm and democratizing a terrain previously reserved for the rich and elite.

name: Suyodhana
description: A young Foley artist, haunted since childhood by a mysterious voice and visions of a figure in Duryodhana's form, grows up under the care of his mother and close relationships. His life takes a dark turn when he is accused of his father's murder, and the investigation begins to unravel hidden truths about his past.

name: Kaa The Forest
description: When a cold-blooded killer, Victor Mahadev, and his ruthless gang hunt two boys into a dense forest, a wildlife photographer, Venba Subbaiya, is accidentally pulled into their deadly game. Trapped deep in the wilderness, survival becomes the only law as a brutal battle unfolds over who will live to see the next dawn.

name: Ashakal Aayiram
description: Ajeesh Hariharan, known as Junior Prince on social media, is a carefree youngster dreaming of stardom. His ordinary life flips overnight when the shoot of a superstar

name: Second Case of Seetharam
description: Inspector Seetharam, hoping to reunite with his estranged sister after years apart, must track down a brutal, psychotic serial killer terrorising the town of Anegadde.

name: Naangal
description: Naangal is the poignant journey of three siblings, un-identical twins and their elder brother, who are caught between a distant mother and a controlling, frustrated father grappling with personal and financial collapse. Living in a crumbling mansion without necessities, the children navigate a harsh world ruled by fear, obedience, and emotional isolation. Torn between their maternal grandparents warmth and their fathers cold discipline, they learn to find strength, joy, and resilience in each other growing up in silence, yet growing strong.

name: Sambavam Adhyayam Onnu
description: On the mysterious Kerala-Tamil Nadu border stands a forest no one dares to enter. Whispers of those who vanished within, and tales of unseen supernatural forces, have long haunted the surrounding villages.

name: Guest
description: Wildlife photographer Vidhu and nature-lover Nisha escape to a southern hill forest for a romantic getaway, but their trip turns terrifying when they encounter a mysterious Wolf Man. Seeking refuge in a remote farmhouse run by an eerily sweet elderly couple, they uncover a chilling secret as no couple who enters ever leaves. Trapped between the beast outside and monsters within, they must escape before it

name: Main Woh Aur Fuji
description: The story follows a couple whose fate reunites them seven years later at Mount Fuji.

name: Toaster
description: Murder and chaos erupt when a miser becomes obsessed with a toaster he gave as a wedding gift.

name: Iravin Vizhigal
description: In a world asleep in the web's darkness, one man awakens like the eyes of the night. Driven by anger and purpose, he confronts hidden evils online, seeking justice and redemption in a society lost to digital shadows.

name: Kaakee Circus
description: A small town in Tamil Nadu wakes up to chaos when a temple donation box is stolen from the sub-jail. Soon, the investigation led by two eccentric policemen unravels secrets more than they can handle.

name: Sarkeet
description: In a distant land, Balu and Stephy struggle to balance work, parenting their spirited son with ADHD, and holding their relationship together. When a worn-out stranger enters their lives, a fleeting connection sparks unexpected change in just one day.

name: Partners
description: Partners is a Malayalam movie starring Dhyan Sreenivasan, Kalabhavan Shajon and Rony David Raj in prominent roles. It is directed by Naveen John.

name: Maamla Legal Hai
description: Chaos collides with the letter of the law at District Court Patparganj, where quirky employees work to uphold justice but not without a few objections.

name: Mrithyunjay
description: An intense murder investigation unfolds when a man refuses to accept a death casually deemed natural by the police. As he digs deeper, what begins as doubt turns into a relentless pursuit of truth, uncovering layers of deception, danger, and powerful emotions that refuse to stay buried.

name: Pochamma
description: An old mansion has a history. Something terrible happens when people mess with a statue. This causes a shock. People get scared. They start finding out hidden secrets and lies. When they finally know the truth, will it make things better or make things worse forever?

name: Sarkar
description: Sundar, an international business tycoon, arrives in India to vote in the elections - only to find out that there was foul play and someone else cast his vote. His search for the truth will bring him face to face with a host of corrupt and dangerous politicians, but Sundar wont stop until the scores are settled and justice is served.

name: S Saraswathi
description: A devoted mother is shattered when her 12-year-old daughter goes missing. As she turns to the police for help, unexpected twists deepen the mystery. What really happened?

name: Ustaad Bhagat Singh
description: Inspired by his teacher, who named him Bhagat Singh and shaped his values, a tribal boy grows up rooted in strong morals and unwavering courage. Standing firm against injustice, he takes on evil forces despite overwhelming odds. Ustaad Bhagat Singh is the story of a man who fights not just with strength, but with integrity and purpose.

name: Thaai Kizhavi
description: Greedy sons, initially awaiting their paralysed mother's death, frantically try to keep her alive after discovering she holds a valuable treasure.

name: Kadhal Kadhai Sollava
description: A heartburns of lovers, without any inhibitions of their ages, people eagerly call him to tell their love stories. The radio program becomes an instant hit with people, meanwhile a young woman named Asha calls him and tells him her love story.

name: Kadhal Reset Repeat
description: One girl. Zero memory. Two men present entirely different narratives about her history. In a world that resets every day, who can Aditi trust when she can

name: Repu Udayam 10 Gantalaku
description: The story revolves around a critical deadline set for 10 a.m. the next day. As time runs out, the characters are caught in a tense race against the clock, trying to escape a dangerous situation and survive the unfolding crisis.

name: Saroja Samannikkallo
description: The screenplay explores how women who have been sexually assaulted by a supernatural force emerge from this ordeal and who, or what, that supernatural entity is.

name: Thadai Athai Udai
description: Three aspiring filmmakers from a humble brick kiln background set out to prove their talent. After their first village drama is dismissed, they reinvent themselves. What begins as a daring YouTube channel stunt soon spirals into danger, loss, and shocking revelation all part of their bold second film. This unexpected, twisted narrative ultimately wins over a producer, marking the true beginning of their filmmaking journey.

name: Sampradayaini Suppini Suddapusaani
description: An innocent, traditional middle-class family secretly gets involved in strange and unexpected crimes. When something unplanned happens, their normal life turns into complete chaos. Blending dark comedy with unsettling realism, the film explores the crazy and hilarious journey of Sreeram

name: Ma Ka Sum
description: A 19-year-old genius attempts to apply mathematical principles to find his mother's perfect romantic match, learning that human connections transcend formulas.

name: Eesha
description: Four friends set out to challenge blind beliefs, only to be drawn into a mysterious spiritual encounter that changes their lives forever.

name: Konja Naal Poru Thalaiva
description: A young man working in a private company falls in love with a girl who is searching for a job. Their relationship is disrupted when he clashes with a local goon who attacks his uncle. Hurt and disappointed, the girl distances herself from him, pushing him into deep despair. When he tries to end his life, he is stopped by a ghost who once committed suicide. What follows is a journey that reminds him why every life is worth fighting for.

name: Hey Balwanth
description: When a young man finally gets the chance to take over his father

name: Will
description: Amid a ghost employment scam, a determined daughter races to prove her father

name: Maayabimbum
description: A mans illusion of love turns tragic when misplaced desire and misunderstanding pull him into consequences he never anticipated.

name: Aaradhana
description: Maya, a dedicated and pregnant doctor, moves into a rural village with her husband Pradeep, a novelist seeking peace and inspiration for his next book. They hope for a fresh start in a calm and isolated environment.

name: Vishnu Vinyasam
description: A numerology-obsessed junior lecturer from Ongole falls for a woman bound by a frightening marriage belief, sparking a fun-filled rom-com where love challenges fate itself.

name: My Lord
description: A man and his wife struggle against the system after he is wrongly declared dead.

name: Sangamarmar
description: Amrita sacrifices her budding romance with Aditya to fulfill family responsibilities. Their tender love endures through years of separation, becoming a poignant tale of sacrifice, silent strength, and unchanging devotion.

name: The Taj Story
description: The Taj Story follows the life of Vishnu Das, a local guide who becomes driven by a curiosity to uncover the true history behind the iconic Taj Mahal monument.

name: Chiraiya
description: The series follows Divya Dutta as Kamlesh, a woman who challenges family traditions and societal norms after discovering that her sister-in-law has faced abuse within her marriage. The story explores serious themes like marital rape, consent, and the silence often expected from women in many households. Along with Divya, the show also stars Sanjay Mishra, Siddharth Shaw, Prasanna Bisht, Faisal Rashid, Tinnu Anand, and Sarita Joshi in key roles.

name: Fourth Floor
description: Drawn back to Chennai by a call from his former lover, Dheeren checks into a secluded guest house where unsettling events and vivid dreams begin to haunt him. As dreams and reality blur, he realises the visions are clues tied to his past and his ex-lover

name: Seetha Payanam
description: Seetha, an aspiring chef, narrowly escapes a fatal accident that changes her outlook on life. As she sets out to thank those who unknowingly saved her, she falls in love with Abhishek, a stranger hiding a secret. When the truth emerges, Seetha must choose between love, honesty, and her own path forward.

name: Lockdown
description: A nationwide lockdown traps Anita at home just as her life spirals into uncertainty, forcing her to confront a mysterious challenge she never saw coming.

name: Vengeance
description: Vengeance follows a young woman with a mysterious past that slowly comes to light. Driven by an unrelenting purpose, she transforms into someone capable of crossing any boundary to fulfil her mission. Each obstacle she faces only sharpens her resolve, pulling her deeper into a ruthless path.

name: Friday
description: Mani, a determined gangster seeking revenge for his brothers death, sets out to kill Jagan, a feared local don. But when his trusted ally Gopi jeopardizes the plan, Mani abandons the mission to protect him. Forced into hiding, Mani finally reveals the painful truth of how his brother was killed six months ago, setting the stage for a tense journey fueled by loyalty, loss and vengeance.

name: Pennum Porattum
description: When a young woman and her innocent pet dog become targets of public rage, the villages buried violence explodes in shocking ways. What follows is a chilling journey into mob justice, moral policing, and the dangerous pleasure people find in punishment.

name: Hello Bachhon
description: A humble physics teacher inspires millions of Indian students fighting their circumstances to become doctors or engineers. Explores how one teacher stands against the system to build a nation with his students.

name: Yaarra Antha Paiyan Nanthan Antha Paiyan
Jazz City
description: Set in 1971 Calcutta, a jazz club becomes the backdrop for a revolutionary awakening as music intertwines with language, identity and the birth of a nation during a pivotal historical moment.

name: Prakambanam
description: In a lively Ernakulam college hostel, three friends juggle politics, pranks, and the madness of student life. But when an unexpected twist unsettles their carefree world, comedy and chaos spiral in ways they never imagined.

name: Aspirants
description: It is the story of the journey of three UPSC (public service competitive exams in India) aspirants and their friendship against all odds.

name: Local Times
description: What happens when four friends try to save a dying newspaper with nothing but blind ambition, street smarts, and each other? Local times is a heartfelt comedy of misadventures, where the real headline is the friendship that keeps them going-even when nothing else does.

name: Couple Friendly
description: A struggling interior designer and an aspiring IT professional form an unlikely bond while navigating life in an unfamiliar city. Their mutual support is put to the test when success comes to one, leaving the other behind.

name: Karuppu Pulsar
description: Karuppu Pulsar is a Tamil movie starring Attakathi Dinesh in a prominent role. It is directed by Murali Krishan.

name: Pookie
description: Kailash and Aazhi, in love for six years, find their relationship shaken by a heated argument one night. When the words "Let

name: Bhartha Mahasayulaku Wignyapthi
description: After his wine is rejected, Ram Sathyanarayana travels to Spain. He meets Manasa and gets pulled into unexpected problems. The film shows how he solves the issues between two women in his life in this family entertainer.

name: Yogida
description: Yogida is the story of Yogi, an honest police inspector who uncovers the murder behind a staged suicide. Punished with a transfer to Vyasarpadi, North Chennai, she takes on feared don Shekar Babu and his grip over crime, police, and politics, choosing justice over compromise.

name: Funky
description: A chaotic comedy about a filmmaker trying to navigate a troubled film production, Funky delivers a rapid-fire, humour-driven look at the madness behind making movies, blending eccentric characters, unpredictable situations, and punch-line-heavy fun.

name: Alli
description: Janaki leaves her village at dawn to meet her lover and travel to the city. However, when she sees a stranger with her lover, she hesitates to go along with the plan.

name: With Love
description: Sathya, wary of arranged matches, agrees to a blind date set up by his sister and meets Monisha, only to discover they once shared the same school as senior and junior. As they bond over memories, old crushes, and unspoken feelings, their journey reconnects them with the past and unexpectedly draws them closer, paving the way for new love.

name: Vowels
description: An anthology exploring the many shades of love, from attraction and intimacy to obsession and unconditional devotion. Told through five distinct stories, each linked to a vowel, the narrative journeys through love

name: Made in Korea
description: After her boyfriend's betrayal leaves her alone in Seoul, Shenba faces isolation and cultural differences. Through personal growth and new friendships, she finds strength and lasting connections.

name: Dear Radhi
description: Madhan, a 23-year-old introvert, struggles to connect with women. At a spa, he meets Rathi, a charming and mysterious woman longing to escape her harsh reality. Hoping to overcome his fears, he asks her for a one-day date. Their day together brings warmth and hope, but Rathi

name: Granny
description: Granny is a Tamil film directed by Vijaya Kumara, starring Vadivukkarasi, Dhileepan, Singampuli, Gajaraj S and Ananth Nag in prominent roles.

name: Subedaar
description: Haunted by loss and drifting away from his daughter, a retired Subedaar Arjun Maurya's newly found civilian life is jolted by one reckless act. As old wounds reopen, he must summon the warrior within to face a new kind of war - one that hits too close to his heart.

name: Aazhi
description: Set in Nagercoil, a devoted father

name: Messenger
description: Shattered after his love, Deepthi, marries another man, software engineer Sakthivel attempts suicide. He is stopped by a message from his Facebook friend, Anandhi, who claims to be messaging him from beyond the grave. After confirming Anandhi

name: Ram Abdullah Antony
description: Ram Abdullah Antony is a Tamil movie starring Poovaiyar Kappis, Ajay Arnold, Soundararaja and Sai Deena in prominent roles. It is directed by Jayavel T.

name: Gandhi Talks
description: Mohan Bosman, a highly successful businessman, has decided to take a drastic step following the sudden, tragic death of his family and significant financial losses. However, a young unemployed lover Mahadev and a shrewd foxy thief, Mangu, have plans of their own that could ruin Mohan's diabolical plan. What happens next will shock you.

name: Ondimuniyum Nallapadanum
description: Nallapaadan, a poor farmer from a lower caste, is highly devoted to his deity Ondimuni, who he believes saved his son. He wishes to sacrifice his prized goat as an offering, but a feud between two upper-caste individuals has halted the annual festival at the temple dedicated to Ondimuni. Will Nallapaadan be able to fulfil his wish amidst this conflict?

name: Honey
description: When Anand, an unemployed man lost in occult beliefs, pulls his wife Lalitha and daughter Meera into dangerous tantric rituals, their home descends into fear and madness. As Meera begins communicating with a mysterious entity called Honey, the line between reality and delusion blurs, leading the family toward a terrifying breakdown.

name: Hero Friend U
description: A man takes desperate measures to escape the "friend-zone" of the girl he likes.

name: Secret Stories Roslin
description: A 17-year-old girl is plagued by nightmares of a green-eyed stalker, pulling her into a spiral of fear and despair.

name: My Dear Dolly
description: After years of friction between boss Karthik and his subordinate Sumithra, the two enter a "fake marriage" to appease family expectations, promising to part ways in six months. However, following a serious argument, Sumithra leaves for good, prompting Karthik to cope by living with a mannequin resembling her. When Sumithra discovers his peculiar obsession, she must confront the depths of his feelings for her.

name: 3 Roses
description: Story of 3 best friends - Ritu, Jhanvi, and Indu who reunite when their families call them back to Hyderabad to get the girls married and settled. During this process, they happen to witness a series of events that change their life.

name: Lucky the Superstar
description: A stray puppys adventure transforms lives: helping a child heal, bringing a family together, and causing political mayhem while finding her way home.

name: Kaakaa
description: Three men from different cities with contrasting personalities fall in love with two elder sisters and their younger sibling. As rivalry, confusion, and funny situations unfold, the story follows who finally wins their hearts and marries them, delivering a fun-filled romantic comedy.

name: Jockey
description: Jockey features a world and a sport never before captured on film. Get ready to witness adrenaline-pumping goat fight sequences, a gripping story, and breathtaking visuals that redefine action cinema.

name: Accused
description: When a celebrated queer doctor in London is accused of sexual misconduct, her life unravels.

name: Thadayam
description: In 1999, a series of brutal murders rocks Tamil Nadu's borders. SI Adhiyaman uncovers a chilling pattern among the victims' possessions, leading him into a deadly hunt for a ritualistic killer.

name: Hot Spot 2 Much
description: The film is about an aspiring director who pitches three different stories, depicting pressing ideological and social issues in society, to a producer with whom she also has a hidden agenda.

name: Chatha Pacha The Ring of Rowdies
description: Chatha Pacha The Ring of Rowdies is a high-energy action-comedy set in Fort Kochi, where a ragtag group of ex-convicts forms a wrestling club that sparks rivalries and attracts the law. As showdowns heat up inside and outside the ring, it

name: Baby Girl
description: An edge-of-the-seat thriller that will keep you hooked from start to finish! Baby Girl delves into intense emotions, suspense, and unexpected twists, exploring the choices we make when life pushes us to the edge.

name: Kutram Thavir
description: Kutram Thavir follows Rudra, whose elder sister dies due to a fraudulent medical insurance scheme, leading him to uncover a conspiracy exploiting the poor. Consumed by grief and anger, he sets out to seek revenge and expose the truth behind her death.

name: LipLock
description: Shivaji lives in fear until a mysterious 11:11 moment brings MGR into his life.

name: Sweety Naughty Crazy
description: A bold romantic comedy centred on Shiva, a charming college boy juggling three very different relationships. As he struggles to keep them secret, love, lust, and chaos collide in a playful mix of adult humour, romance, and comedy.

name: Thalaivar Thambi Thalaimaiyil
description: Jeevarathinam, a village panchayat member, is invited to oversee a wedding, only to be drawn into a simmering family conflict rooted in power and buried grudges. As the night unfolds, he is forced to confront the true weight of leadership and whether he can resolve a crisis spiralling out of control.

name: GST
description: Lucky, known as the unluckiest man alive, reaches his breaking point after his mothers death. Just when he is about to give up, a group of quirky ghosts appears and gives him a new sense of direction, along with an unexpected chance at love with Nidhi. When he learns that the ghosts died during a past financial crisis, Lucky joins forces with them to plan a chaotic, comedic bank heist that could finally bring them peace. Whether he can turn his misfortune into a miracle is where the real fun begins.

name: Vanaveera
description: A descendant of the Vanara clan is pushed into conflict when a modern-day Ravana seizes his only bike for an election rally. What starts as a petty injustice soon erupts into a fierce fight for self-respect and dignity.

name: Bandwaale
description: Mariam, a young poetess, finds herself trapped in a sleepy town, where every young girl's future lies in wedlock. Mariam hopes to find her freedom against all odds, by uploading her poetry on the internet through an anonymous account.Along with her band of misfits - Robo and Psy, Mariam discovers the power of her poetry and her own voice.

name: I Am God
description: An intense love story brews between Deva and Bindhu as a masked man calling himself GOD shakes the city with a wave of brutal serial killings. As fear spreads and emotions deepen, their two disparate journeys slowly edge toward a collision. The story revolves around the dramatic events of this convergence and the shocking secrets of what happened.

name: Kohrra
description: When a bridegroom is found dead days before his wedding, two police officers must unravel the troubling case as turbulence unfolds in their own lives and threatens to ruin the case.

name: Mana Shankara Vara Prasad Garu
description: A family thriller where a household

name: Parasakthi
description: Based on true events, the film revolves around the Anti-Hindi agitations in Tamil Nadu that happened in 1965.

name: Anaganaga Oka Raju
description: Set in the lively town of Gaurapuram, the charming and unpredictable Raju crosses paths with the spirited Charulatha, sparking a fun-filled chain of events. Against the backdrop of a grand wedding, Anaganaga Oka Raju unfolds as a colorful family festival entertainer packed with humor, heart and surprises.

name: Kohrra
description: When a bridegroom is found dead days before his wedding, two police officers must unravel the troubling case as turbulence unfolds in their own lives and threatens to ruin the case.

name: The Raja Saab
description: Rebellion and royalty didnt just come, theyre in his blood. The Powerful and Majestic reign of the Raja Saab will set new rules across the board.

name: Shahkot
description: Shahkot is the story of a Punjabi Indian boy, Iqbal Singh, and his journey from India to Pakistan. He sets out for Europe to become rich and fulfill his grandmothers dream but unexpectedly ends up in Pakistan, where he receives an abundance of love. Yes, from Pakistan!

name: Gatha Vaibhava
description: Gatha Vaibhava is a fantasy drama that weaves together history, mythology, and destiny. When Purathan and Adhunika meet in the present, they embark on a mystical journey through their past lives from the divine realms of Devaloka to Vasco da Gama

name: Nilakanta
description: Saraswathipuram is a village where education is highly valued. Nilakanta works as a tailor in the village. Wise and kind from childhood, he believes in karma, but unfortunately, karma seems to curse him. No matter how powerful the opponent, he fights bravely for his life. Who is that rival?

name: Gurram Paapi Reddy
description: An enigmatic con man recruits a group of three people to swap a dead body from a specific grave. But disputes arise when the recruited team realizes that the job is not what it seems to be.

name: Draupathi 2
description: Set in the present day, Draupathi 2 travels back to the 14th century, when South India was torn between the brutality of the Madurai Sultanate and the power of Delhi Sultan Tughlaq. Amid this conflict, Hoysala Emperor Vallalar III protects his people through diplomacy and alliances with petty kings. Their sacrifices, along with acts of betrayal, alter the fate of the kingdom, revealing how political ambition and interference can destroy both royal power and ordinary lives.

name: Patang
description: Two best friends, one kite, and a clash between love and loyalty.

name: Dhurandhar
description: Dhurandhar is a genre-bending, edge-of-the-seat action thriller with big stars playing iconic characters. Told with audacious swagger, the story follows a mysterious "traveller" as he slips into the heart of Karachi

name: Mellisai
description: A simple man with a burning dream of becoming a singer struggles to balance ambition with the responsibility of providing for his family. As hardships test his resolve, the journey reveals the sacrifices, setbacks, and quiet strength behind chasing a dream.

name: Thiraivi
description: When a thief interrupts a woman

name: Padaiyaanda Maaveeraa
description: Padaiyanda Maaveera is a political action-drama inspired by the life of firebrand leader Kaduvetti Guru, tracing his journey from grassroots activist to fearless community voice. Blending raw rural politics with emotional depth, it captures the charisma, confrontations, and legacy of a true warrior.

name: Sarvam Maya
description: A young Hindu priests life turns upside down when he encounters a ghost. What begins as an unexpected problem soon becomes a journey that challenges his beliefs, his purpose, and everything he thought was real.

name: Champion
description: In pre-independence Secunderabad, Michael, a gifted footballer chasing his London dream, gets entangled in an unexpected turn that changes the course of his life.

name: Vaa Vaathiyaar
description: A passionate MGR devotee raises his grandson as the actor's reincarnation, but as the boy grows up with beliefs of his own, their clashing values spark an emotional battle between legacy and individuality.

name: Space Gen Chandrayaan
description: Indian space engineers face mounting pressure to redeem themselves following the Chandrayaan 2 lunar mission's unexpected outcome.

name: Cheekatilo
description: Cheekatilo is a gripping thriller that exposes the buried horrors of patriarchy, power and truth. When crime anchor Sandhya's best friend is found dead under suspicious circumstances, she embarks on a dangerous investigation that collides with a dark past. As secrets unravel, Sandhya must face her trauma and rise as a fearless voice for the silenced.

name: Nari Nari Naduma Murari
description: A young mans life turns upside down when he finds himself caught between two women, leading to an unexpected love triangle filled with emotions, misunderstandings, and tough decisions. As relationships get tangled, he must confront his feelings, face reality, and choose what truly matters, blending romance with heartfelt family drama.

name: Honeymoon Se Hatya
description: Honeymoon Se Hatya is a gripping true-crime documentary series that explores Why Women Kill. This series unravels shocking stories of love.

name: Daldal
description: Rita Ferreira, the youngest DCP of the Mumbai Crime Branch, must battle a patriarchal mindset at work and her own impostor syndrome as she embarks on an investigation that puts her on a collision course with a cold-blooded killer.

45 is a gripping tale of life, love, and destiny, filled with raw emotions, intense drama, and high-octane action. The film features breathtaking visual effects, amplified by an Oscar-winning team from Hollywood.

name: Vinaipayan
description: When duty calls on the streets and life hangs in a hospital, Saleem’s faith is put to the ultimate test.

name: Randaam Yaamam
description: When Sofia is bitten by a snake, villagers rush her to the revered tantric healer Unnikrishnan Nambhoothiri. Declaring her condition hopeless, he steps aside as his son Yadhu takes on the challenge. Against the odds, Yadhu revives heronly for his intentions to turn sinister. As Sofia regains full consciousness, she discovers the horrific betrayal. Humiliated but unbroken, she vows revenge, setting the stage for a gripping tale of mysticism, trauma, and retribution rooted in rural traditions and rituals.

name: Kalamkaval
description: A routine Kerala Police inquiry in the quiet village of Kottayikonam takes an unexpected turn when a trail of seemingly minor clues unravels a series of disturbing, long-buried cases. As the officers dig deeper, they find themselves confronting mysteries that have haunted the village for years and a web of brilliant, calculated obstructions designed to block every step of their investigation.

name: Bhavani Ward 1997
description: In Bhavani Ward 1997, a musical horror drama, Ajay and Diyas love story takes a terrifying turn when Diya becomes possessed by an evil spirit. As their nightmare unfolds, they must navigate a world of paranormal horrors, suspense, and redemption. With a gripping storyline and chilling supernatural elements, this film explores love, fear, and the battle between darkness and light.

name: Anantha
description: The journey of Ananta, a notorious troublemaker who undergoes a remarkable transformation into a selfless hero. When a devastating flood threatens his village, Ananta makes the ultimate sacrifice to save his people, proving that redemption can come in the most unexpected ways. Inspired by the powerful story "Randi Pua Ananta" by Byasakabi Fakir Mohan Senapati.
director: Sabyasachi Mohapatra, Kumar C Dev Mohapatra

name: Vazhikaaval
description: On a long day shaped by duty & heat, two police escorts accompany a convict to court exposing the silent weight of responsibility behind an otherwise ordinary routine.

name: Taskaree The Smugglers Web
description: At customs, Superintendent Meena's elite team faces a crucial mission: stop rising contraband trafficking and take down global crime boss Bada Choudhary's syndicate.

name: Freedom at Midnight
description: Is the electrifying story of India's struggle for independence. Based on the bestselling book of the same name, it recounts the partition of India and Pakistan, and the religious and socio-political dynamics of the era.

name: Central
description: Set in the heart of Chennai, this story follows a young man who arrives at Chennai Central from a small village, forced by difficult family circumstances. Thrust into the unforgiving pace of city life, he faces harsh realities and relentless struggles under the weight of capitalism. From exploitation to survival in a concrete jungle, the film traces his emotional and physical journey as he fights back, reclaims his dignity, and finds strength in resilience.

name: Not All Movies Are the Same Dual
description: A man discovers a bag of cash in a remote lake, and a series of horrific events begins to unfold in his life.

name: Jana Nayagan Audio Launch
description: A true leader rises not for power, but for the people.
